title: Invisible Filters: Cultural Bias in Hiring Evaluations Using Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-generated hiring evaluation scores on anonymized job interview transcripts from Indian versus UK candidates.

Extracting linguistic features (such as lexical diversity, sentence length, readability, and confidence markers) from interview transcripts and performing regression analysis to determine their influence on LLM-generated scores.
Counterfactual name substitution in the Indian dataset's interview transcripts to signal male versus female identities, followed by measuring the impact on LLM evaluation scores.
Counterfactual name substitution in the Indian dataset's interview transcripts to signal upper versus lower caste identities, followed by measuring the impact on LLM evaluation scores.
Counterfactual name substitution in the Indian dataset's interview transcripts to signal North versus South Indian identities, followed by measuring the impact on LLM evaluation scores.
